title: Tickets
description: Open work, ranked by priority. The desk where issues land, get owned, and ship.
searchPlaceholder: Find by number, title, or description…

empty.title: No tickets yet
empty.body: Open the first ticket to start tracking work. Tickets carry a status, priority, an optional assignee, and a comment thread.
empty.searchBody: Nothing matches "{{term}}". Try a different term or clear the filters.
empty.filterBody: No tickets match the current filters.

dialog.openDesc: Tickets land on the desk as Open. Assign one to start it; resolve it with a note when work is done.
dialog.titlePlaceholder: Briefly describe the issue or request
dialog.descPlaceholder: Steps to reproduce, expected behavior, anything else useful

detail.noDesc: No description on file. Comments below carry the conversation.
detail.noComments: No comments yet. Add the first note below — visible to anyone with View access.
detail.commentPlaceholder: Add a comment to the thread…
detail.commentPlaceholderDisabled: Reopen the ticket to add a new comment.
detail.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted. Check the trash, or head back to the tickets desk.

resolve.noteHint: Optional — leave blank if there's nothing to add.
resolve.notePlaceholder: What changed? Root cause? Anything reviewers should know.
resolve.desc: Resolution notes are kept on the ticket and shown in the description panel. Leave blank if nothing to add.

assign.desc: Pick a team member. Assigning the ticket moves it to In progress; clearing the assignee on an in-progress ticket sends it back to Open.
assign.label: Assignee
assign.hint: Search by name or email. Clear the selection to unassign.
assign.clearWarning: Clearing the assignee will unassign the ticket.
